cases.sentence: Они пришли к Иисусу в Гилгалский лагерь и сказали ему и израилетянам, «Мы пришли из далекой ___».
cases.translation: They came to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, 'We have come from a far country.'
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они пошли и собрали в дорогу еды и нагрузили своих ослов ветхими ___.
cases.translation: They went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governing 'loaded with' uses the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: На ногах у них были поношенные и залатанные ___.
cases.translation: Old and patched sandals were on their feet.
cases.explain: Сандалии is the predicate nominative after the verb 'были' (were).

cases.sentence: Израилетяне сказали Хивеям, «А вдруг вы живете рядом с нами, как же нам тогда заключать с вами ___?»
cases.translation: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, 'How could we make a covenant with you?'
cases.explain: The direct object of заключать (to make/conclude) takes the accusative case.
The preposition о (about) with the meaning 'concerning' governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Спустя три дня после того, как они заключили союз с гаванитянами, израилетяне узнали, что это их ___.
cases.translation: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors.
cases.explain: The nominative plural form serves as the predicate nominative after узнали (they heard/learned).

cases.translation: The princes of the congregation swore to them.
cases.explain: The instrumental скрепить (to seal with) takes the instrumental case.

cases.translation: All the congregation murmured against the princes.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) always governs the genitive case in the plural form.

reading.ru: Они пошли и собрали в дорогу еды и нагрузили своих ослов ветхими мешками и ветхими мехами для вина, изорванными и заплатанными.
reading.question: What did the Gibeonites load their donkeys with to make themselves appear as if they had traveled a long distance?
options: Old sacks and old, torn, patched wine skins
reading.correct: Old sacks and old, torn, patched wine skins
reading.explain: The text describes нагрузили своих ослов ветхими мешками и ветхими мехами для вина, изорванными и заплатанными — they loaded old sacks and torn, patched wine skins.

reading.ru: Весь хлеб, что они взяли с собой, был черствым и заплесневелым.
reading.question: What condition was the bread that the Gibeonites brought with them?
reading.explain: The text states весь хлеб, что они взяли с собой, был черствым и заплесневелым — all the bread they took was dry and moldy.

reading.ru: Мы пришли из далекой страны, заключите же с нами союз.
reading.question: What did the Gibeonites ask the Israelites to do?
reading.explain: The Gibeonites requested заключите же с нами союз — make a covenant with us.

reading.ru: Израилетяне попробовали их припасы, но не спросили Господа.
reading.question: What mistake did the Israelites make regarding the Gibeonites' covenant proposal?
options: They sampled their provisions but did not ask counsel from the Lord
They refused to make a covenant with them
They gave them all their gold and silver
reading.correct: They sampled their provisions but did not ask counsel from the Lord
reading.explain: The text says они попробовали их припасы, но не спросили Господа — they tasted their supplies but did not consult the Lord.

reading.ru: Иисус призвал гаванитян и сказал, «Почему вы обманули нас, сказав, мы живем далеко от вас, тогда как вы живете рядом с нами?»
reading.question: What accusation did Joshua make against the Gibeonites?
options: They deceived them by claiming to live far away when they lived nearby
They stole food from the Israelite camp
They refused to serve as slaves
They attacked the Israelites without cause
reading.correct: They deceived them by claiming to live far away when they lived nearby
reading.explain: Joshua asked почему вы обманули нас, сказав, мы живем далеко от вас, тогда как вы живете рядом с нами — why did you deceive us by saying you live far away when you live near us.

reading.ru: Теперь вы прокляты. Вы всегда будете работать дровосеками и водоносами для дома моего Бога.
reading.question: What punishment did Joshua pronounce on the Gibeonites?
options: They would serve as wood cutters and water carriers for God's house
They would be enslaved to other nations
They would be driven out of the land
They would lose all their possessions
reading.correct: They would serve as wood cutters and water carriers for God's house
reading.explain: Joshua declared вы всегда будете работать дровосеками и водоносами для дома моего Бога — you will serve as wood cutters and water carriers for my God's house.
